original.statement: A status condition for binding AuthorizationPolicy to a waypoint proxy is now written to the AuthorizationPolicy status; the formatting of these conditions is experimental and will change.

of.needed: whether the AuthorizationPolicy targetRefs resolve to a waypoint proxy

corrected.statement: Istio now writes an experimental status condition on AuthorizationPolicy resources that are bound to a waypoint proxy through targetRefs. Policies with multiple targetRefs get a single condition. Exposed environments have an AuthorizationPolicy with spec.targetRefs pointing at a waypoint proxy.

decision.reason: [ev-1fd772318bb8] says the status condition is written for binding an AuthorizationPolicy to a waypoint proxy via targetRefs, not for every AuthorizationPolicy. The proposed exposure (any use of AuthorizationPolicy, and only at v1beta1, a version the evidence never names) is broader than the affected environments. Exposure should be limited to AuthorizationPolicies with spec.targetRefs set. Whether the target is a waypoint proxy can't be decided from the evidence, so that part is marked undecidable.
